title: Same Tree
statement: Given two binary trees as level-order lists `a` and `b`, return True if they are structurally identical with the same node values.
brute_force_code:
def is_same_tree(a, b):
    return a == b

predict_steps.prompt: If both nodes are None, what do you return?

viva.question: Why can you compare two trees in linear time?
expected_points: each corresponding pair of nodes is examined once
values and null structure are checked together
a mismatch can reject without walking the rest
total work is proportional to the smaller differing size, at most O(n)

viva.question: When are two null roots considered the same?
expected_points: both empty trees have identical structure
null versus null is the successful base case

viva.question: Why does a null versus non-null mismatch fail immediately?
expected_points: short-circuiting avoids walking a nonexistent child
the trees cannot be equal once structure diverges
